title: スワンSの後に・強くおっきく！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I felt so relaxed while running, but I was able to zoom by so fast!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Everyone around me was piping hot with passion, like lasagna fresh out of the oven!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I hope I can run just as well as I did today at the Mile Ch.! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since she didn't have any issue running a 1,400-meter graded race, I doubt she'll have any issues at the Mile Ch.
choice_data_list: We've got one month left! Let's make it count!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up for us is the Mile Ch., the biggest event in fall where the best gather to race!
